programme.desc: 'S10/E10'. Hy word beskryf as 'n goeie ou en 'n Christen. Wanneer die oud-Bloubul Phindile Ntshongwana in hegtenis geneem word vir 'n reeks grusame bylmoorde, is almal totaal geskok deur sy optrede.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S10/E11'. 'Die lewe het goedkoop geword.' Dit is die woorde wat die regter in die hofsaak uiter na Daniël Botha in 2018 in 'n nagklub in Benoni doodgeslaan en -geskop word na 'n woordewisseling handuit ruk.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S10/E12'. In die middel 90's in Botswana word Ria Wolmarans vermoor. Aanvanklik word 'n inbraak vermoed, maar wanneer Mariëtte Bosch maande later gearresteer word, en Ria se man boonop met Mariëtte trou.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S10/E13'. In die 1970's saai William van der Merwe - bekend as Die Skroewedraaier Maniak - verwoesting in Suid Afrika. Hy verkrag 9 vrouens oor 'n baie kort tydperk na hy hulle met 'n skroewedraaier dreig.

programme.title: Gekies Vir Die Kollig!
programme.desc: 'S5/E4'. In episode vier betree ons 'n magnetiese veld - dis Span Lindsey Abrahams. Line Allen sny diep en Janru Steenkamp reik na die sterre. Hierdie span speel nie net met teks nie - hulle vorm 'n wentelbaan van nuwe wêrelde.

programme.title: 'n Nuwe jy met Nova
programme.desc: 'S2/E1'. Elana van der Walt neem 6 deelnemers op 'n reis van vernuwing. Eerste aan die beurt is Frans Mans, wat al op 20 sy hare begin verloor het. Innerlike genesing en 'n haaroorplanting sit weer 'n nuwe huppel in sy stap.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S30/E12'. Toe Johan van Dyk se drome van erfgrond nie realiseer nie, het hy sélf oor die afgelope 2 dekades sy boerdery in die Standerton-omgewing opgebou.

programme.title: Goeiemôre, good morning

programme.title: Erfenis in die grond
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Heuningkrans: Die Prinsloos van Heuningkrans is al vir ses generasies merino-boere in Smithfield in die Vrystaat. Kom stap saam in die spore van dié skaapboere.

programme.title: Nisboere

programme.desc: 'S3/E152 - The Platinum Job'. Somhlolo asks Chuma to transport more platinum, but Chuma is hesitant due to trust issues. Nomsa blocks Jafta's number, choosing self-protection over reconciliation.

programme.title: Gold Diggers
programme.desc: 'S2/E27 - Drawing Board'. Ruth has invested half of the money in the dodgy investment scheme. Dimpho helps get Lucky a job but only for a cut of his earnings. May has an odd interaction with Mpho.

programme.title: Yosef
programme.desc: 'S1/E147'. The Kirimlis go to ask Seher's hand in marriage. Nothing can sway Hayriye from accepting Kara as suitable for Ibo.

programme.title: Chrysalis
programme.desc: 'S3/E6'. Nalan wants to speak to Hayri. The Koroglu's gets a big surprise. Feride's suspicions about Hayri and Nalan grows.

programme.title: Impak!
programme.desc: 'S1/E56'. Feast your eyes on an awkward family reunion while the ghosts of the past continue to haunt them. Kadir seeks out the name of his protector and tormentor, will he find out that they're one in the same?

programme.title: Love Of My Life
programme.desc: 'S1/E58'. A forbidden passion between Mariana Azcarate, the heiress of the cotton plantation La Victoria and Joaquín Mosquera, an Afro day labourer.

programme.title: Naagin
programme.desc: 'S6/E92'. Mahek plans to attack the children at Unnati Ground during the Christmas party to get Prathna out of hiding.

programme.title: eExtra Insert
programme.desc: We bring entertaining and informative stories for your enjoyment.

programme.title: Voetspore
programme.desc: 'S7/E7 - The Farmers Of Mkushi'. The week begins at the grave of Upington just outside Lusaka then, a visit to the farmers of Mkushi in central Zambia, where an impressive farming industry has been developed over several decades.

programme.title: Dokter Ali
programme.desc: 'S2/E3'. Ali follows his heart, but the consequences are dire. Demir shares shocking news with Acelya. Beliz is confronted with a difficult decision.

programme.title: Yosef
programme.desc: 'S1/E148'. Seher is nervous about the visit from social services. Zuhal has a plan to hurt Seher. Kiraz tries to comfort Kara.

programme.title: Kelders Van Geheime
programme.desc: 'S2/E148 - 2/148'. Debbie-Lee and Tjoppie start a new chapter together when Veronique dangerously intervenes. Annette and Du Toit seem happy until Du Toit takes it too far. Warren discovers a stranger lurking on the farm.

programme.title: Gelukbringers
programme.desc: 'S1/E196 - 1/196'. Azra, who studied culinary arts in America, returns home to celebrate her father's birthday. However, upon her arrival, her world is shattered overnight.

programme.title: Blink Kant Bo
programme.desc: 'S2/E104 - 2/104'. Suna is determined to get rid of Pelin. Ifakat plants a seed of doubt in Halis' mind, Ferit fears the worst is yet to come and he may be right.

programme.title: Chrysalis
programme.desc: 'S3/E7'. Rafet wants Sedat to apologise to Alp. Tako is snooping around in Nalan's room. Alp threatens Cana once again.

programme.desc: 'S1/E57'. It's a rush against time as Kadir makes his way to Veli who was taken by Ivan. Kerem and Cemre reluctantly ask help from Demir.
